notes: SCOPE: everything beyond the PokeCottage standard Ditto master set (ditto-pokecottage.json: English/Japanese/Simplified-Chinese standard printings). Do not merge the two lists without de-duplicating: the standard list already holds the English/Japanese/Simplified-Chinese version of every card named here, including the Vending Series 2 Ditto (num 32), the Meiji PCG-P 108 Ditto, the Origins 2007 / Games Expo 2007 event-stamped EX Delta Species Dittos, and the 2009 World Championships Deck Ditto — none of those are repeated here. LANGUAGE-VARIANT IMAGES: the image on a language-variant row is the English printing's image (same artwork in every language); per-language images were not separately verified. CORRECTED NUMBERS (verified Nov 26, 2026): Legends Awakened Ditto is 27/146 (not 131/146; 131/146 is Cynthia's Feelings, confirmed via Pokemon TCG API); Triumphant Ditto is 17/102 (not 40/102; 40/102 is Machoke, confirmed by reading the card image); Detective Pikachu Ditto is 17/18 (not 5/18, confirmed via Pokemon TCG API). UNVERIFIED — NEEDS CHECKING: Portuguese Pokemon GO Ditto 053/078 (Bulbapedia language list was truncated at Italian; French/German/Italian/Spanish confirmed); Korean Boundaries Crossed Ditto number (row uses Japanese Cold Flare number 042/059 by inference); EX Delta Species Ditto 62/113 and 64/113 transformed forms in the artwork; Korean/Traditional-Chinese/Indonesian/Thai prints exist at set level for the Sword & Shield / Scarlet & Violet-era Ditto cards (Crown Zenith, 151, Pokemon GO, Shining Fates, Lost Thunder, Detective Pikachu, Paldean Fates, 30th Celebration) but per-card numbers were not verified, so no rows were added for them; Korean prints of other Japanese-only Ditto sets (e.g. Clash at the Summit, Temple of Anger, Tag All Stars) likewise unverified. REEL-CLAIMED CAMEOS NOT VERIFIED (checked visually against hires card images Nov 26, 2026; NOT included): Imposter Professor Oak (Base Set 73/102 — no Ditto visible; the purple shape is a shadow); Bebe's Search (Mysterious Treasures 109/123 — the reel's '109/130' is PlusPower; the real art shows Glameow and a mug too small to identify); Department Store Girl (Arceus 85/99 — shows Pachirisu, no Ditto); Ortega (Obsidian Flames 190/197 — no Ditto visible); Minccino (no official printing identified — only a fan-made custom card found). OTHER UNVERIFIED: Topps Series 2 tin topper 'Ditto (Pikachu)' jumbo chrome card (mentioned ambiguously on Bulbapedia); Kingler (1997 Pocket Monsters Carddass) Ditto cameo (named in a Jun 2026 carousel; which Carddass part unverified); no Ditto card found in Topps Series 1, Topps 3D, Topps Johto, or Topps Movie checklists consulted (not exhaustively verified). ITALIAN EARLY SETS: Bulbapedia's expansions-in-other-languages table leaves Italian blank for Fossil and Skyridge, but the set pages and marketplace listings confirm Italian prints exist (Cardmarket Italian Ditto 3/62 and 18/62; graded Italian Skyridge Crystal Ho-Oh) — Italian rows kept. 30TH CELEBRATION IMAGES: no 30th Celebration card images were on images.pokemontcg.io as of Nov 26, 2026 (me55/28, me55/115, me55/149 all 404) — image null. TOPPS / VENDING / OTHER rows have no verified image URLs — image null.
